description: This file declares functions related to asynchronous subscription handling in the rbus library, including adding, removing, retrieving subscriptions, and closing handle operations.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribe_AddSubscription
methods.description: Adds a new subscription for a specified event with a given payload.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribe_RemoveSubscription
methods.description: Removes an existing subscription based on the subscription details provided.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribe_GetSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves an existing subscription matching the handle, event name, and filter.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribe_CloseHandle
methods.description: Closes or releases the handle associated with subscriptions.
